title: Method to Destroy the Core
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji finally pieced together the complete truth of the Destined Twinborn, the figure at the very forefront of the Demonic Path army made him feel as though he'd fallen into an ice pit—that was the other half of his sister Chen Nian's soul, missing for many years.

text.content: Within the Mental Sea, the will of the Heavenly Eye was like a massive ice pick forged from eternal cold, piercing through Chen Ji's soul barrier. That transcendent pressure almost crushed his consciousness into dust. Yet what shattered him even more was the mournful cry from the endless darkness—that was his sister Chen Nian's voice, the desperate struggle of blood-related kin in the abyss of fate.

dialogue.content: "A mere ant dares to gaze upon my true form?" The will of the Heavenly Eye thundered like divine punishment, "You think that fragment can protect you? Laughable. You are merely the most insignificant discarded piece among my countless chess games."

text.content: Chen Ji bit down hard on his tongue tip, using the sharp pain to barely maintain mental clarity. After walking the world with a废物废物 image for so many years, he'd long grown accustomed to being trampled, despised, treated as insignificant dust. But the Heavenly Eye's high-handed indifference now ignited a fierce killing intent in his chest he'd never felt before. He noted it down—this debt, Chen Ji would remember it.

dialogue.content: "Brother...save me...it hurts...they're going to merge me...with that person..." Chen Nian's voice came in fragments, each word seeming to be squeezed from a shattered soul, intermingled with cries and pleas.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Merged? Who? What had been done to his sister? He wanted to roar in response, but found his consciousness tightly钳制 by the Heavenly Eye's pressure, unable to move even a finger. Helplessness like a tide drowned him—this feeling was more suffocating than all the humiliations he'd suffered as a servant at Tianqing Sect.

dialogue.content: "Want to know the answer?" The Heavenly Eye's will carried a hint of mockery, "Then use your defective foresight to guess—if you guess right, perhaps you can see her one last time; if you guess wrong, you'll become nourishment for my core alongside her, never to be reborn."

text.content: Just as Chen Ji's consciousness was about to collapse, an ancient yet familiar voice rang out from the depths of the Tianji Record Fragment. It was a mysterious existence he'd never seen—Chen Tianming, Chen Xuan's previous inheritor, another tragic figure who had been manipulated by the Heavenly Eye for ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: "Enough." Chen Tianming's voice was placid as water, yet carried undeniable authority, "Heavenly Eye, your opponent is me, not this child. Since he's already come this far, some truths, you cannot prevent me from revealing, nor can you hide from him."

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's will abruptly faltered, the force crushing Chen Ji's Mental Sea receded like a tide. It seemed to be hesitating, weighing something. After a moment, that transcendent existence coldly vanished into the void's depths, leaving only a sinister warning: "Chen Tianming, you think telling him the truth can change anything? The script of destiny was written long ago."

Chen Ji gasped for breath, his entire clothing soaked through with cold sweat. He felt his soul had been torn apart and stitched back together, every inch screaming. But he didn't fall—he couldn't fall—his sister was still waiting for him, his only blood relative in this world.

dialogue.content: "Child, you did well." Chen Tianming's voice softened somewhat, "Maintaining clarity under the Heavenly Eye's oppressive will shows your soul is more resilient than I anticipated. Now, listen carefully—about how to destroy the Heavenly Eye's core, about the price you must pay, about...your sister's true destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed his churning emotions, forcing himself into that心如止水的 calm state. After so many years of playing the pig to eat the tiger, he'd long mastered maintaining rationality under extreme pressure. Emotionalism is the privilege of the weak, and he—Chen Ji—was going to become the one who overturns the chessboard.

dialogue.content: "The Heavenly Eye's core lies within the Chaotic Void above the Nine Heavens." Chen Tianming's voice was steady and clear, "That is the birthplace of all things, and also the forbidden land condensed from the countless seers' souls it devoured. To destroy it, you need three keys to activate simultaneously."

"The first key is the complete version of the Tianji Record." Chen Tianming spoke slowly, "The fragment in your hand is merely the tip of the iceberg. The true Tianji Record consists of nine pages, containing all heavenly secret calculations from the universe's birth to its end. You must gather all fragments and reconstruct the complete Tianji Diagram."

text.content: Chen Ji's heart tightened. Nine pages of the Tianji Record, and he currently held only a fragment. This one page alone had drawn countless factions to covet and pursue him—if he gathered all nine pages... No, now was not the time to consider such things. He suppressed his surging thoughts and listened quietly.

dialogue.content: "The second key is the power of the Destined Twinborn." Chen Tianming's voice suddenly grew grave, "The Heavenly Eye feeds on Heavenly Fate and drinks destiny. And the Destined Twinborn—one is the successor chosen by the Heavenly Eye, one is the variable it deliberately erased—when the two unite, they can shake the fundamental operating laws of its foundation."

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head abruptly. Destined Twinborn? Successor? Variable? These words collided wildly in his mind, piecing together a possibility that made his entire body go cold. He remembered his sister's desperate cry for help just now, remembered the Heavenly Eye saying it would merge her with "that person"—

dialogue.content: "Yes, you guessed correctly." Chen Tianming sighed, "Chen Nian is the erased variable. And the other half of her intertwined fate is among the Demonic Path army—the Demonic Path commander is the successor chosen by the Heavenly Eye for this generation. Your sister was taken by the Holy Sect precisely to complete this destined 'merger'."

text.content: Chen Ji's nails dug deep into his palms, blood dripping through his fingers, yet he was oblivious to the pain. The Demonic Path commander—that terrifying existence leading the Demonic Path army to sweep across the three sects—was actually fatefully intertwined with his sister in such a bizarre way? Rage like a venomous snake gnawed at his heart, but he took a deep breath and forcibly suppressed that surge of brutality.

dialogue.content: "The third key is the recognition of the Cosmic Eye." Chen Tianming continued, "The Heavenly Eye is not the only will existing in this world. Above it lies the Cosmic Eye that governs the causality of all realms. Only with its recognition can the key truly insert into the core's lock."

text.content: "The Cosmic Eye..." Chen Ji repeated softly, his mind racing. The Cosmic Eye—an existence even more ethereal than the Heavenly Eye, one he had never even seen mentioned in any classic text. This third key held the greatest variables.

choice.prompt: After stating the conditions for the three keys, Chen Tianming fell silent for a moment, seemingly waiting for Chen Ji's reaction. At this moment, he needed to make a decision—regarding the direction of the next move.

choices.description: Can't wait any longer. My younger sister is suffering every moment. I must immediately go to the demonic army to rescue Chen Nian, even if there's only a slim hope.
choices.visible_cost: Might fall into the encirclement of the demonic army, losing all strategic advantages.
choices.visible_reward: Might rescue my younger sister, interrupting the fusion process of the Twin Destinies.
choices.risk_hint: Going deep into the enemy camp alone, facing near-certain death.
choices.process_label: 决定立即前往魔道大军

dialogue.content: "Impulsive." Chen Tianming's voice carried a hint of disappointment. "You think with your current strength, you can snatch someone from the demonic army commander? That would only be sending yourself to death. Remember, once you die, everything will truly be over."

choices.description: Analyze the situation calmly. The three keys are indispensable. Acting rashly will only alert the enemy. Need to secretly gather more intelligence first and formulate a thorough plan.
choices.visible_cost: The sister's suffering might worsen during the waiting period.
choices.visible_reward: More sufficient preparation, more complete plan, higher success rate.
choices.risk_hint: Might miss the best timing, the fusion of the Twin Destinies completes.
choices.process_label: 决定暗中布局等待时机

dialogue.content: "This is the answer I wanted to hear." Chen Tianming's voice revealed a hint of appreciation. "But I must remind you, timing is something that once missed, will never come again. You need to find a way to break the situation before that fusion completes."

choices.description: The conditions for the three keys are too harsh. Is there an alternative that can bypass these restrictions? Perhaps I can extract more information from Chen Tianming.
choices.visible_cost: Might anger Chen Tianming, losing important guidance.
choices.visible_reward: Might discover a hidden fourth path, or obtain crucial information.
choices.risk_hint: Angering the only being willing to help him.

dialogue.content: "Are you testing me?" Chen Tianming fell silent for a moment, then let out a meaningful laugh. "Clever. But I must tell you, there are no shortcuts on these three paths. Do you know why I failed back then? It was precisely because I was too impatient, trying to bypass the rules of fate—and was counterattacked by those rules, falling into eternal doom."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, pressing all surging emotions deep into the bottom of his heart. Anger? Anxiety? Fear? None of these were useful. What he needed was calmness, calculation, that version of himself who could find a way out even in the most desperate situation. Having played the useless person role for so many years, his greatest skill was silently laying plans and biding his time when everyone looked down on him.

dialogue.content: "There is one thing I must tell you now." Chen Tianming's voice suddenly became unprecedentedly solemn. "The demonic army commander... is not at all the ancient monster you might imagine, cultivated for a thousand years. In reality, like your sister, he was deliberately created by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets as a 'vessel'. They were originally one, forcibly split into two halves, each bearing half of destiny."

text.content: Chen Ji's breath suddenly stopped. One body split into two? Two halves? Countless thoughts collided wildly in his mind, suddenly piecing together a hair-raising possibility—if the demonic army commander and Chen Nian were originally one person forcibly split apart, then when he and his sister "fuse"...

dialogue.content: "That's right. Once the fusion completes, they will merge into one, becoming the perfect 'Twin Destinies Vessel'." Chen Tianming's voice was cold as iron. "Then, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets will have an almost perfect inheritor—one with both mortal emotional bonds and power beyond the mortal realm. This existence will completely shatter the balance of the Three Realms, turning everything you and I cherish into nothingness."

text.content: Chen Ji felt as if all the blood in his body was flowing backward. His sister... that girl he swore to protect for a lifetime, was to be forcibly merged with a demon? Fate? Damn this fate! His heart roared, but his face remained as calm as still water—that useless person facade. This was his last trump card—no one could see his true emotions.

dialogue.content: "Child, remember, your advantage lies in your ability to endure." Chen Tianming's voice suddenly warmed slightly. "If I had been able to hide my abilities like you back then, perhaps I wouldn't have reached that point. What the Eye of Heavenly Secrets fears most has never been power, but rather those variables it cannot predict. You... are the variable it failed to calculate."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, a cold and eerie light burning in his eyes. Variable? He liked that word. When everyone thought he was a useless fool, he had been waiting for this moment—waiting for the chance to overturn the entire chessboard. And now, the chance had arrived.

choice.prompt: After Chen Tianming finished speaking, the light on the Tianji Record Fragment gradually dimmed, and his power seemed unable to sustain much longer. In this final moment, Chen Ji needed to make a crucial decision.

choices.text: Pressing about the Demonic Path Commander's Identity
choices.description: Who exactly is the Demonic Path Commander? Since he and Chen Nian were originally one being split apart, is it possible to win him over and turn him into an ally against the Heavenly Eye?
choices.visible_cost: Consuming more remnant soul power from Chen Tianming, possibly causing him to dissipate earlier
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining key intelligence, possibly discovering enemy weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming may not be able to hold on until the end of the volume
choices.process_label: 决定追问魔道主帅真相

dialogue.content: "Alright, I'll tell you." Chen Tianming's voice grew increasingly faint, "The Demonic Path Commander... his original name, was Chen Nian."

text.content: Chen Ji was struck like by lightning. Chen Nian? His sister's name? No, this can't be a coincidence. What exactly is the Heavenly Eye planning? Why split one person into two halves, and use the same name?

choices.description: Where is Chen Nian now? When will the fusion ceremony begin? He needs to know the specific time and location to devise a rescue plan.
choices.visible_cost: Missing the opportunity to learn the Demonic Path Commander's true identity
choices.visible_reward: Obtaining key intelligence: sister's location and fusion time

dialogue.content: "She is in the deepest part of the Demonic Path army—within the 'Heavenly Fate Altar' built for her by the Holy Sect." Chen Tianming said, "The fusion ceremony will take place seven days from now on the Blood Moon night. At that time, the Heavenly Fate power of the entire Three Realms will converge here."

choices.text: Planning the unification of the three keys
choices.description: Among the three keys, he already possesses the Tianji Record Fragment. If he can find clues to the other two keys within seven days, perhaps he can reverse the situation before the fusion is complete.
choices.visible_cost: May need to abandon some existing arrangements and expose partial strength
choices.visible_reward: May simultaneously advance three leads, greatly increasing success rate
choices.risk_hint: Splitting focus may result in each direction not being deep enough

dialogue.content: "Pursuing three lines simultaneously..." Chen Tianming pondered for a moment, "This is a dangerous move, but you have no choice. Remember, the clues to the Universe's Eye may be hidden right beside you—that person who has been trying to get close to you may know something."

text.content: Chen Ji calculated rapidly in his heart. Seven days, three keys, two near-impossible missions. For anyone else, perhaps despair and giving up would be the only option. But for him, this was just a new chess game. In this lifetime, what Chen Ji excelled at most was playing an excellent hand in desperate situations.

dialogue.content: "Everything I can tell you, I've already said." Chen Tianming's voice was like a candle in the wind, flickering toward extinction, "The road ahead, you must walk alone. Remember, the true power of the Tianji Record lies not in foresight, but in... change. Fate is not unchanging; it merely waits for a strong enough chess player to rewrite it. Child, go, become the one who rewrites fate."

text.content: As the words fell, the light on the Tianji Record Fragment dimmed completely. Chen Tianming's presence dissolved into the void, leaving only Chen Ji alone, standing at the crossroads of fate. In the distance, the war drums of the Demonic Path army echoed faintly—that was the deadly trap set by the Heavenly Eye, and also the stage for Chen Ji to defy heaven and change his fate.

dialogue.content: "Seven days..." Chen Ji murmured, a slight upward curve at the corner of his mouth—that was a hunter's smile, "That's enough."

text.content: He turned, looking at the world he had secretly cultivated for many years behind him. The Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, White Tiger Sect—the chess games of these three great sects were already thoroughly understood by him; the Holy Maiden faction led by Ye Qing was his hidden trump card; Su Qingyao's investigation was both crisis and opportunity. And now, a new piece had fallen into his chessboard—the Demonic Path Commander entangled with his sister's fate, that pitiful existence manipulated by the Heavenly Eye for ten thousand years.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, the Tianji Record Fragment warming slightly in his Mental Sea. He knew that using the foresight ability came at the cost of precious Heavenly Fate, but at this moment he couldn't afford to worry about that. He needed to see more, needed to find that path to victory within the chaotic mist of fate.

dialogue.content: "Twin Destinies..." he murmured, the name revealed by Chen Nian echoing endlessly in his mind—the Demonic Path Commander's true name was actually the same as his sister's? Chen Nian, what secrets lay hidden within this?

text.content: At that moment, a graceful figure silently appeared beside Chen Ji. Su Qingyao, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect—the woman who had come infinitely close to the truth three times, only to be thwarted by him three times. Her gaze carried scrutiny and worry, and in her hand she clutched a Communication Jade Slip.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, there's unusual activity from the Demonic Path Army." Su Qingyao's voice was characteristically cold, but if one listened carefully, one could detect a hint of urgency within. "According to scouts, the Demonic Path Commander said something very strange before the formation—he said he had finally found his long-lost other half."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He knew that所谓的"另一半"，正是他的妹妹陈念。可笑的是，魔道主帅或许根本不知道自己也是被天道之眼操控的棋子，他以为自己是在"找回"什么，实际上却是在执行毁灭一切的计划。 the so-called "other half" was none other than his sister Chen Nian. How ironic—the Demonic Path Commander probably had no idea he was merely a chess piece manipulated by the Heavenly Eye. He believed he was "reclaiming" something, but in truth, he was executing a plan to annihilate everything.

dialogue.content: "There's one more thing." Su Qingyao's voice suddenly dropped lower. "I discovered that the Demonic Path Commander's true name... might not be Demonic Path Commander at all. The Holy Sect has erased all records of him—it's as if... as if someone deliberately wanted to erase his former identity."

text.content: Turbulent waves crashed within Chen Ji's heart, but his expression remained that of a cowardly, timid man—even trembling slightly upon "hearing news of the Demonic Path Commander." This was his perfect disguise—making everyone believe he was merely a spineless waste, while they remained ignorant of the sky-shaking great web rapidly being woven within his mind.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." Su Qingyao suddenly called his name, a complex emotion flickering in her gaze. "I don't know what you're hiding, but I want you to know... no matter what happens, in the Inner Sect of Tianqing, there will always be a place for you."

text.content: Chen Ji paused slightly. He appreciated Su Qingyao's kindness, but at this moment only one thought occupied his mind—seven days, just seven days. Within these seven days, he had to find the three keys, prevent the fusion of his sister and the Demonic Path Commander, destroy the core of the Heavenly Eye, and rewrite this destined script that had been written for ten thousand years.

dialogue.content: "Su Senior Sister..." He raised his head, revealing a bitter yet cowardly smile. "Thank you. But... there are some things I must face myself."

text.content: With that, he turned to gaze at the northern sky, dyed crimson by war's flames. There, the wheel of fate had already begun to turn, and he—Chen Ji, this waste mocked by all—was about to become the one who pried that wheel.

When Chen Ji finally pieced together the complete truth of the Twin Destinies, the figure standing far at the very front of the Demonic Path Army froze him to his core—it was the other half of his sister Chen Nian's soul, missing for years.
